name: rhdh-operator-pr-test
description: Tests an rhdh-operator pull request's CI-built operator, operator-bundle, and operator-catalog images on a live OpenShift cluster with oc, and reports evidence plus rollback. Use for "test this operator PR on a cluster", redhat-developer/rhdh-operator PR images or bundles, OLM CatalogSource and Subscription from a PR catalog, quay.io/rhdh-community/operator, or deploying a PR's CI bundle with oc.
